evals.prompt: I'm building a task management app called 'TaskFlow' for remote teams. The app helps distributed teams track sprints, assign tasks, and visualize progress with kanban boards. Target audience is tech-savvy professionals aged 25-45 who work remotely. Create the complete visual identity and design system for this product.
evals.expected_output: Design.md file in the working directory with color palette (light + dark), typography, iconography, spacing system, border radii, shadows, and brand identity sections
expectations: Creates a Design.md file in the current working directory
Design.md contains a JSON design tokens block with colors, typography, spacing, borderRadius, shadows
Design.md includes both light and dark color palettes
Design.md specifies at least one font family from Google Fonts
Design.md specifies an icon style and recommended library
Design.md includes a spacing scale with at least 4 levels
Design.md includes a border radius scale
The color palette has sufficient contrast for readability

evals.prompt: I'm working on a project management web app. I have a Design.md with my visual identity already set up. I need to design a profile dropdown menu that has edit profile, settings, and logout items. What should it look like? Make sure it fits with the existing design language.
evals.expected_output: The skill checks if a 'Profile Dropdown' or similar component already exists in Design.md. If not, it designs one using existing design tokens and appends it to Design.md.
expectations: Checks if a profile dropdown component already exists before creating it
Designs the dropdown using existing design tokens from Design.md (or creates Design.md first if it doesn't exist)
The dropdown design includes properties derived from the token set (colors, spacing, radii, shadows from tokens)
The dropdown has at minimum Default, Hover, and Disabled states defined
The dropdown design is appended to Design.md under the Components section
Uses the design_tool.py script to check and append components

evals.prompt: I already have a Design.md with a complete design system for my e-commerce app. The design already includes buttons, cards, and a navbar. Now someone on my team wants me to design a button. But I think we already have that. Check if the button is already designed and tell me what to do.
evals.expected_output: The skill checks if 'Button' exists in Design.md and reports that it's already designed, without creating a duplicate.
expectations: Uses the design_tool.py check command to verify if Button exists in Design.md
If Button already exists (or if Design.md doesn't exist yet, creates one first then checks), does NOT create a duplicate design
Informs the user that Button is already designed rather than redesigning it
Does not overwrite or duplicate existing component designs
